evidence.reason: The matching-existing-file branch in `ArtifactStore.put` returns success without any directory synchronization. A prior `atomic()` call can have replaced the file and then failed at `fsync_dir(filename.parent)`; a retry then sees matching bytes and skips that durability step. This is inconsistent with `put_file`, which calls `durable_directory(destination.parent)` before checking existence and explicitly persists the directory entry even when the artifact already exists (lines 441+). The repair is a routine durability fix: fsync the artifact directory on the matching-existing path as well.
